div.div: 5 تنغّصت عِيشَتُهُ , (S,) or مَعِيشَتُهُ, (K,) His state of life, (S,) or his means of subsistence, (K,) became troublesome, or perturbed, or attended with trouble; syn. تَكَدَّرَتْ. (S, K.) You say also, نَغِصَ أَمْرُهُ, inf. n. نَغَصٌ, [His affair, or case, became troublesome, &c.;] (A;) [for] ↓ نَغَصٌ is syn. with تَنَغُّصٌ as signifying تَكَدُّرٌ (Har, p. 273).
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
